subject: Physics
prompt: A man walks 40 m due east, then 50 m due north, then 60 m due west. Find the magnitude and direction of the resultant respectively: (tan^{-1}(0.4) = 21.8° and cos^{-1}(0.4) = 66.4°).
explanation_steps: Direction: tanθ = 50/20 = 2.5, but given tan^{-1}(0.4)=21.8° so θ=68.2° from west or similar; north west.

subject: Physics
prompt: The ideal mechanical advantage (I.M.A.) of a simple machine is always
options: greater than the actual mechanical advantage.
it depends upon the nature of the simple machine.
sometimes greater than and sometimes less than actual mechanical advantage.
explanation_steps: Ideal MA assumes no friction/losses, so IMA >= AMA always, typically greater when friction present.

subject: Physics
prompt: In some state of matter the molecules are widely separated and can move almost freely in any direction. Which state of matter satisfies this condition?
explanation_steps: In a gas, molecules are widely separated and move freely in any direction.
Solids have fixed positions; liquids have molecules close but can flow.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which one of the following in SI unit of time is approximately equal to one day? (Give your answer in two significant figures)
explanation_steps: One day = 24 hours * 60 min * 60 s = 86400 seconds.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which one of the following physical quantities is a scalar?
explanation_steps: Displacement, velocity, acceleration, and force are vectors.

subject: Physics
prompt: In motion along a straight line, what does the slope in a velocity-time graph represent?
explanation_steps: Slope of velocity-time graph is acceleration (Δv/Δt).
